[LSER.16.8.3] `bool_and` / `bool_or` are **not** admitted under the
`sample` time model. They are exact predicates, not statistical
summaries: a uniform reservoir can omit the one value that determines
the AND/OR, so the reduction over the sample is not faithful. The
compiler rejects `bool_and sample <n>` / `bool_or sample <n>` with
`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_AGG_TIME_MODEL_MISMATCH` — see
[LSMP.3]. (The `SeriesBackendReservoir` runtime backing
can compute them over the bag, but that path is unreachable in v1.)
